name: Opus-fleet price momentum
strategy: Concentrate in the strongest intact 12-month US equity momentum themes — semis, biotech, tech and small-caps — using select leverage where the trend is still working.

positions.thesis: Strongest and accelerating momentum in the table (+4.7% 1w, +6.3% 1m, +5.6% 3m); new energy leadership.
Retained momentum leader: +10.8% 1m, +11.4% 3m; biotech remains one of the strongest trends.
Positive across all horizons (+2.2% 1w, +8.4% 1m, +9.6% 3m); regional banks leading the rotation.
Financials firmly trending (+1.0% 1w, +4.5% 1m, +7.7% 3m) with steady positive slope.
Defensive momentum leader (+0.2% 1w, +7.4% 1m, +8.7% 3m); positive when tech is breaking down.
Value factor carrying relative momentum (+0.5% 1w, +3.2% 1m, +9.5% 3m) as growth reverses.
Small-cap 3x still holds strongest 3m momentum (+16.7%) with only mild 1w pullback; tight stop guards a reversal.
Small-cap breadth complement, positive 1m/3m (+1.4%/+6.9%) with far less drawdown risk than tech.

reassessment_note: Week 1 desk (2026-07-18): Semis/tech momentum decisively broke (SMH -10.8% 1m, SOXL -42.1% 1m, both worst in table); a price-momentum book cannot hold 47% in the worst-momentum sectors, so rotate into confirmed new leaders (energy, banks, financials, healthcare/biotech, value).
novelty: Momentum leadership rotated out of the high-beta semis/tech/leveraged-growth driver of R1/R2/R3; this book now rides price momentum in cyclical/defensive leaders (energy, regional banks, financials, healthcare, value) — a materially different return driver.
